# POIESIZ Interiors

> Modern & custom interiors. A Kochi-based turnkey contracting company specialised in interior design and execution for residential and commercial spaces in Kerala.

## Services
- Complete turnkey services: design, interior execution and MEP services such as electrical, plumbing and air conditioning
- Residential interiors: luxury homes, penthouses and flats
- Commercial interiors: retail shops, showrooms and commercial buildings
- Office interiors: cabins, bay areas, receptions, meeting and conference rooms, cubicles and pantry

## Key pages
- /: Home, with services, projects, ideas by room and style, clients, process, contact and FAQs
- /price-calculator: Step-by-step interior cost estimator
- /projects/chai-bazaar: Chai Bazaar retail shop for Kannan Devan Hills Plantations, Munnar
- /projects/cubespace: Cubespace office interior, Kakkanad, Ernakulam
- /projects/mr-vinod-s-residence: Residence interior, Aluva
